evidence: Issue #877 requires a merge candidate or a distinct unresolved-merge blocker, and the clean tree with lane commits must reuse its tip.
task_run_checkpoint checks merge state before the empty-lane skip, rejects unresolved conflicts and out-of-scope merge changes, commits a resolved merge, and returns the tip for commit-only changes.
The supplied checkpoint code returns skipped when there are no scoped changes; the attention-state declaration also describes that as a typed terminal state, consistent with #816.
#822 checkpoint discipline was pinned but its contract and implementation were not supplied, so compatibility with it cannot be verified.
target_observations.summary: The checkpoint logic appears to address merge and clean-tree cases while preserving #816’s no-empty-checkpoint rule, but I cannot establish compatibility with #822 from the supplied semantic input.

evidence: Issue #878 identifies Claude CLI rejection of the draft 2020-12 $schema key and expects stderr in the lifecycle reason.
reviewer_worker_backend._command removes only the top-level $schema key before serializing the schema for claude -p.
execute_backend reads the first nonempty stderr line and appends it to the typed backend-failed message when the process exits nonzero.

The visible tests cover these cases, but the reviewer worker runtime, lifecycle consumer, and authoritative backend contract were not included; end-to-end propagation and absence of contract regressions remain unverified.
target_observations.summary: The supplied backend strips the unsupported top-level schema key and includes captured stderr in nonzero-exit errors, but the pinned reviewer worker backend contract cannot be established from the supplied input.

evidence: Issue #879 reports false path candidates from dotted identifiers, foreign slash tokens, and the “scope mismatch” phrase.
_keep_candidate admits candidates with a repository top-level foothold or existing path, with file-shaped slash tokens retained as advisory recall; the old phrase switch is absent.
The supplied tests assert no scope for issue.create, origin/main, task/abc, a dotted schema ID, npm scopes, fs/promises, and dotted tokens after “scope mismatch.”
The supplied tests retain new paths under gateway/ and scripts/, retain a file-shaped zebra/qux.ts advisory candidate, and verify preflight derives top-level names from the lane repository.
target_observations.summary: The scope evidence heuristic now rejects dotted identifiers and non-repository slash tokens while preserving advisory recall for file-shaped tokens, and its tests cover the reported examples and #880 recall boundary.
